summary: Cloudflare and Airbnb jump, Atlassian and DraftKings sink, Singapore banks mixed. Your holdings: TTD reports Mon 9 Nov.
note: Covers results released in the ~24 hours to 7:30am SGT, read against a 5.5% Nasdaq fall on Thursday 5 Nov. Figures are from company releases and earnings coverage; estimates are consensus figures as reported by the named outlet. Not investment advice.

items.headline: No holding reported overnight. The Trade Desk is up first, on Monday
items.summary: None of NOW, NFLX, CLSK, CRM, PINS, ONON or TTD released results in the last 24 hours. The Trade Desk reports after the US close on Monday 9 Nov (Tuesday morning in Singapore). It has guided third-quarter revenue to at least $650 million, about 12% below a year ago, which would be its first year-on-year decline as a public company. The September restructuring, which cut about 15% of staff, will also hit GAAP profit.
figures: Q2 recap: revenue $715M (+3% y/y), EPS $0.34 vs $0.40 est.
Number to watch: free cash flow vs $155M a year ago
items.source: The Trade Desk (date notice) via MarketScreener; MarketBeat; Adweek

items.headline: Coming up: On Holding, CleanSpark, Salesforce
items.summary: On Holding reports before the US open on Tuesday 10 Nov. TipRanks lists the date as confirmed, but some calendars show 11 Nov. CleanSpark's fiscal fourth quarter is expected around 24 Nov, and Salesforce's third quarter around 2 Dec after the close. Salesforce has guided that quarter to revenue of $11.42–11.50 billion and adjusted EPS of $3.42–3.44.

items.headline: Cloudflare posts its fastest growth in nearly four years and raises its forecast
items.summary: Revenue rose 39% to $782.5 million, well above its own guidance, as AI and developer workloads grew. Annualised revenue passed $3 billion. Fourth-quarter guidance came in about 6% above consensus, and the shares rose about 13–18% after hours.
figures: Non-GAAP operating margin 17.5% (15.3% a year ago); FCF margin fell to 10%
items.source: Cloudflare release; Benzinga; StockStory via Yahoo Finance

items.headline: Atlassian beats estimates but falls ~17% on its slower growth outlook
items.summary: First-quarter revenue grew 24% and cloud revenue 31%, both ahead of estimates. Management nudged its full-year targets up, but full-year revenue growth of about 13.75% implies a sharp slowdown as Data Center revenue shrinks ahead of its end of life. The stock had nearly doubled since August, which left little room for a cautious outlook.
figures: FY27 guide: revenue ~+13.75%, cloud ~+26%, Data Center ~-16%

items.headline: Arm sets a record quarter, but a soft outlook sends the shares down ~12%
items.summary: Revenue rose 27% to a record $1.44 billion, led by a 50% jump in licensing. Royalties grew only 8% as memory prices squeezed smartphone volumes. Third-quarter guidance barely beat consensus, and charges tied to Arm China weighed on GAAP profit.
figures: AGI CPU: up to $2B revenue across FY27–28
items.source: Arm via Motley Fool transcript; Investing.com

items.headline: Qualcomm drops ~9% as handset chip sales fall 26%
items.summary: Fiscal fourth-quarter revenue reached the top of its guidance. Car-chip sales nearly doubled to a first $2 billion quarter, but handset revenue fell to $5.14 billion. The midpoint of the next quarter's EPS guidance came in slightly under consensus, so the data-centre ramp still has to prove itself.
figures: Q1 guide: revenue $10.4–11.2B, EPS $2.15–2.35 vs $2.27 est.
Data centre: >$650M in Q1, ~$5B targeted for FY27
items.source: Qualcomm release; Quartz (citing CNBC); The Elec

items.headline: AppLovin soars ~31% after a large beat and a strong outlook
items.summary: Revenue grew 55% to $2.18 billion, about $100 million above the top of its guidance, on better ad models in mobile gaming. Fourth-quarter guidance came in well above consensus, and the company bought back $1.4 billion of stock in the quarter.
items.source: AppLovin release via Yahoo Finance; Benzinga

items.headline: Airbnb says it is 'back in growth mode' and adds a $12bn buyback
items.summary: Revenue grew 19%, its fastest pace in over three years, as nights booked rose 16%. Airbnb raised its full-year outlook to high-teens revenue growth with an adjusted EBITDA margin of about 36%, and the shares rose about 7–11% after hours. One caveat: a lower tax charge flattered the EPS comparison.
figures: Nights and seats booked 155M (+16%); new $12B buyback
items.source: Investing.com via Yahoo Finance; CNBC; 24/7 Wall St.

items.headline: DraftKings plunges ~20% on a miss and a lower 2026 outlook
items.summary: Revenue rose 16% but missed estimates, and the loss was wider than expected. DraftKings cut its 2026 revenue and EBITDA guidance to fund a bigger push into prediction markets. It raised its 2027 revenue outlook, but investors focused on the near-term cash burn.

items.headline: Singapore banks: DBS and UOB miss, OCBC edges ahead of estimates
items.summary: DBS's profit fell 5% to S$2.81 billion as markets trading income collapsed 65%, but it kept its 81-cent quarterly dividend. UOB missed and cut its net interest margin outlook, sending its shares down more than 5%. OCBC beat estimates with a 3% rise to S$2.04 billion and raised its 2026 loan growth outlook. It was the only one of the three to meet expectations.
figures: UOB: S$1.25B vs S$1.35B est.; FY NIM now below 1.75%
OCBC: S$2.04B (+3%) vs ~S$2.01B est.; loan growth now low double digits
items.source: Reuters via Business Today; The Manila Times (Reuters); The Edge Singapore

items.headline: Toyota raises its full-year profit forecast despite tariffs
items.summary: Quarterly net profit fell 19% to ¥759 billion, slightly short of estimates. A weaker yen, price increases and a smaller tariff hit let Toyota raise its operating profit forecast by ¥500 billion to ¥3.9 trillion, and the shares jumped in Tokyo.
items.source: AP via WTOP; CBT News; Jiji Press via Nippon.com
